title: BECE English Studies: Vocabulary & Register - NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies - Collocations
subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The national anti-graft agency successfully froze the bank accounts of the fugitive politician accused of massive money ________.
questions.explain: The term 'money laundering' is a strictly recognized legal and governmental collocation referring to the concealment of the origins of illegally obtained money.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

The local health inspectors warned that serving severely undercooked poultry at the cafeteria could trigger mass food ________.
questions.explain: 'Food poisoning' is the standard accepted collocation referring to illness caused by bacteria or other toxins in contaminated food.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

To effectively maintain the fragile ceasefire in the war-torn region, the African Union hastily deployed a multinational peace-________ force.
questions.explain: The term 'peace-keeping' is a globally recognized military and diplomatic collocation referring to the active maintenance of a truce between warring factions by an international military force.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

After several months of deeply bitter domestic disputes, the troubled couple eventually agreed to consult an experienced marriage ________ to save their union.
questions.explain: 'Marriage counselor' is a standard formal collocation for a specialized therapist who actively helps couples resolve interpersonal conflicts and improve their relationship.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

Renowned climate scientists constantly assert that excessive emission of industrial chlorofluorocarbons drastically depletes the protective ozone ________.
questions.explain: In environmental science, the Earth's atmospheric protection against harmful solar radiation is formally collocated globally as the 'ozone layer'.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies
